title: TaskBridge: Technical Report for SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2610.37231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge Query Reformulation Task evaluates the reformulation of task-oriented queries into expressions suitable for product retrieval, followed by BM25-based retrieval. These queries often imply product needs through activity-level semantics, creating a lexical gap with catalog descriptions. Systems must preserve task intent while adapting the number of reformulations to the Automatic and Interactive protocols. We propose TaskBridge, a catalog-anchored framework comprising Catalog Semantic Anchoring, Unified Five-Candidate Rewriting, and Protocol-Aware Selection. It grounds queries in catalog vocabulary, generates five complementary reformulations, and selects one query for Automatic retrieval or up to four for Interactive retrieval using BM25 scores, query-product reranking, and weighted Jaccard overlap. translated_title: TaskBridge：SIGIR 2026电子商务挑战赛技术报告
translated_abstract: SIGIR 2026电子商务挑战赛的查询改写任务评估将面向任务的查询改写为适合商品检索的表达式，随后进行基于BM25的检索。这些查询通常通过活动层面的语义隐含商品需求，与商品目录描述之间形成了词汇鸿沟。系统必须在保持任务意图的同时，根据自动和交互两种协议调整改写的数量。我们提出了TaskBridge，这是一个以商品目录为锚点的框架，包含目录语义锚定、统一的五候选改写和协议感知选择三个模块。该框架将查询锚定在目录词汇中，生成五个互补的改写版本，并利用BM25分数、查询-商品重排序和加权Jaccard重叠度，为自动检索选择一个查询，或为交互检索选择最多四个查询。选定的查询通过BM25独立执行，以生成所需六列格式的结果。
tldr: 提出TaskBridge框架，通过目录语义锚定、五候选统一改写和协议感知选择，将任务导向查询改写为适合商品检索的表达式，有效弥合查询与商品目录之间的词汇鸿沟。
en_tdlr: TaskBridge is a catalog-anchored framework that reformulates task-oriented queries into retrieval-friendly expressions via Catalog Semantic Anchoring, Unified Five-Candidate Rewriting, and Protocol-Aware Selection, bridging the lexical gap between queries and catalog descriptions.
